_note: Every value here was confirmed by direct on-chain read or primary Circle documentation on 2026-09-19. The chain overrides the docs wherever they disagree. Nothing may appear as a constant in the codebase unless it is in this file.

mainnet.blockTimeVerifiedBy: timestamp delta over 10000 blocks at head 21661101

fees.note: Transactions below 20 Gwei maxFeePerGas are silently dropped by the mempool: no receipt, no error, no block inclusion.

usdc.note: One balance, two interfaces. A contract's USDC is its NATIVE balance. Never mix msg.value/address.balance (18dp) with balanceOf (6dp) without scaling.
usdc.contractsMustBePayable: An ERC-20 USDC transfer moves native value. Any contract receiving USDC needs a payable receive().

morpho.verifiedBy: selectors grepped from deployed bytecode; owner() and market() called on-chain

targetMarket.name: cirBTC / USDC
targetMarket.verifiedBy: idToMarketParams + market() read on-chain at block ~21661101

swapVenue.BLOCKER: Exit liquidity for cirBTC is 0.215% of the collateral that would need to be sold. Atomic swap-based liquidation of this market is NOT viable at current depth. Re-read weekly.
swapVenue.verifiedBy: balanceOf(PoolManager) for each collateral asset; V4 is a singleton so this is total on-DEX depth

rpcLimits.note: Exceeding this returns error -32602, NOT a truncated result. Code that swallows RPC errors will silently report zero events. This bit us during Phase 0.
